title: Guard legacy run appends and preserve history
preconditions: A separate legacy fixture has a case, evidence and an initial failed run ci1.

steps.action: Attempt ci2 without the current parent and attempt to overwrite ci1; append valid ci2; introduce a concurrent head, then append a record naming every head.
steps.expected_result: Invalid appends are refused without consuming ci2, current run is absent during conflict, complete reconciliation retains four records, and the original ci1 remains failed.

expected_result: Guard legacy run appends and preserve history.
